headline: Barely a foot of prime SSE — glassy and pointless, one for the loggers.
today: Prime angle on paper but 0.7ft doesn't do much. Morning has the cleanest wind with NNE offshore to cross-off before the SE cross-on and SSE onshore build through the afternoon. Log-only if you're that committed, otherwise wait it out.

daysToWatch.note: Solid 2.2-3.9ft on a good ESE angle with WNW cross-off holding most of the day after a cross-on dawn. Clearly the day to surf — fish or shortboard.
Waist-high leftovers with N offshore in the morning; small but clean groveler window before the S onshore.
Prime SSE angle but only knee-high, and S onshore builds to 13-16mph by afternoon. Early glass at best, then blown.
